_comment: Template: Export the rules of a QoCDC 3.2.1 rule file to Excel.
_how_to_use: Copy to your working directory. Replace REPLACE_WITH_PATH values. Run: java -jar CimPal-CLI.jar qocdc2xlsx --config this-file.json
_note_input: The QoCDC 3.2.1 rule file (RDF/XML, UMLRestrictionRule instances).
_note_output: The workbook: one row per rule, sorted by name.
